title: Slavoj Žižek + Paul Holdengräber "Surveillance and whistleblowers" - International Authors' Stage
summary: Slavoj Zizek and Paul Holdengraber discuss surveillance and whistleblowers at the International Authors' Stage, ranging over Snowden, Assange, Pussy Riot and humor.
why: HN commenters call it an entertaining, complementary philosophical take on surveillance, with a funny story about jamming secret police.

quote.text: I think Slavoj Žižek and Paul Holdengräber on "Surveillance and whistleblowers" is worth a watch.
